# Metadata readiness checklist

Every required attribute in the UK Cross-Government Metadata Exchange Model (xGov MEM, commit `d6d9a24`), class by class, with the model's own description. Tick each one off before you publish. Generated from the model, so it changes only when the model does.

NDL PubSec MCP is an independent prototype. It is not a government service and is not endorsed by any government department.

## ContactPoint

- [ ] **contactName**: The name of the organisational contact to obtain further information or provide feedback about an information resource.
- [ ] **email**: The e-mail address to be used to contact the organisational contact for the resource as listed in the [contact name](/ukgov-metadata-exchange-model/contactName).

## DataService

- [ ] **accessRights**: A rights statement that concerns how the distribution is accessed.
- [ ] **contactPoint**: The organisational contact to obtain further information or provide feedback about an information resource.
- [ ] **creator** (one or more): The business entity responsible for creating or compiling the original content of an information resource.
- [ ] **description**: A concise narrative of the content of an information resource.
- [ ] **identifier**: A unique number, code, or reference value assigned to an information resource within a given context.
- [ ] **licence**: Reference to the legal document outlining access and usage rights for an information resource.
- [ ] **modified**: The date, or date and time, on which the content of an information resource is changed.
- [ ] **publisher**: The business entity responsible for making an information resource publicly available.
- [ ] **securityClassification**: An information security designation that identifies the minimum level of protection assigned to an information resource.
- [ ] **title**: The full and formal name given to an information resource.
- [ ] **type**: The type of the resource being defined
- [ ] **version**: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
- [ ] **endpointDescription**: A description of the services available via the end-points, including their operations, parameters etc.
- [ ] **serviceStatus**: The status of the resource in the context of a particular workflow process. 
- [ ] **serviceType**: The nature or genre of the resource.

## Values from a fixed list

These must match exactly, including capital letters.

- **AccessRightsValues:** `INTERNAL`, `OPEN`, `COMMERCIAL`
- **SecurityClassificationValues:** `OFFICIAL`, `SECRET`, `TOP_SECRET`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`
- **FrequencyValues:** `freq:triennial`, `freq:biennial`, `freq:annual`, `freq:semiannual`, `freq:threeTimesAYear`, `freq:quarterly`, `freq:bimonthly`, `freq:monthly`, `freq:semimonthly`, `freq:biweekly`, `freq:threeTimesAMonth`, `freq:weekly`, `freq:semiweekly`, `freq:threeTimesAWeek`, `freq:daily`, `freq:continuous`, `freq:irregular`
